newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt market closing report.

text.p: Swedish debt yields closed higher, mainly following losses in U.S. Treasuries driven by the U.S. missile attack in Iraq and fears of a sizeable Fed funds rate target increase soon.
Dealers also saw some selling of crowns and Swedish bonds for U.K. gilts and sterling by London banks in the afternoon.
"Considering all this, I think Swedish debt has performed quite well today," said one dealer.
Nine-year bond yields rose six basis points to 8.19 percent while six-month T-bills closed unchanged at 5.06 percent.
